name: Sweet Powernudge

features.name: Nudging reels
features.description: Reels with winning symbols nudge down to reveal new symbols.

features.name: Reel five multipliers
features.description: Multiplier values on reel five boost wins.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Four scatters award seven free spins with the multiplier always active.

review:
A 6x5 candy game where five or more matching symbols win. Whenever a win lands, every reel with a winning symbol nudges down to reveal a new one, which can make more wins without another spin.

Reel five carries multipliers for base-game wins. Four scatters give seven free spins with the multiplier meter always active, and four more scatters add three spins. Up to 4,000x, 96.08% RTP. A lighter Powernudge than Sugar Supreme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
